map.按模式选正则：字母模式与单词模式取 [a-zA-Z]+，字母数字模式取 [a-z: Choose the regex by mode: letter and word modes use [a-zA-Z]+, alphanumeric mode uses [a-zA-Z0-9]+, identifier mode uses [a-zA-Z][a-zA-Z0-9]*, and global matching yields candidate words. Post-processing order: filter by minimum length first (default length ≥ 2), then deduplicate (keyed by lowercase when lowercase is on, otherwise by the original word), then normalize case (to lowercase or uppercase), and finally sort — lexicographic sort directly when case has been normalized, otherwise compare with localeCompare on toLowerCase. The output count equals the result array length, joined with the selected separator (a separator of \n joins with line breaks)
